title: 2 TV Shows Take on Sam Bankman-Fried and FTX
summary: The limited series “The Altruists” and the documentary “The Boy Who Stole Billions?” offer different takes on the crypto exchange founder’s role in one of the largest frauds in history.
body_markdown: The limited series “The Altruists” and the documentary “The Boy Who Stole Billions?” offer different takes on the crypto exchange founder’s role in one of the largest frauds in history.
